name: R4-M17
description: R4-M17 was a hardworking, but stubborn astromech droid. Her Arc welder had an intermittent short, and her third leg could no longer retract, but otherwise she was a skilled worker. The unit was owned by a moisture farmer, who bought it from the Jawa Traders shop in the center of Mos Eisley.

data.name: R4-M17
equipment: Cybot acoustic signaler (Droid and computer languages)
